text:
Opus 5.5 is getting scary good at building things, not just writing code.

This entire pixel-art scene is written in TypeScript.

Rain.
Fire.
Smoke.
Flickering lights.
Particles.
Environmental animation.

And it took ~10 minutes.

The interesting part isn't the pixels.

It's the ability to describe a world and get a living, working scene back.
